title: Leadership Advisor for a new Toastmasters club
summary: District 82 recognized me for helping a new club grow its membership.
what_would_have_happened: A newly formed club risks losing members before it becomes self-sustaining.
the_call: Mentor a new club's leaders instead of only speaking at my own.
what_i_did: Served as Leadership Advisor under the district's Club Incubation Center.
what_changed: The district recognized the club's membership growth.

quotes.text: Toastmasters International, District 82 recognizes, Dattatreya S Vellal for successfully serving as a 'Leadership Advisor' under the Club Incubation Center

images.alt: Certificate: Leadership Advisor for a new Toastmasters club
